name: Chapungu Sculpture Park
subtitle: Chapungu is a 20-acre sculpture park on the outskirts of Harare showing Zimbabwean stone sculpture, also called Shona sculpture.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Began as a small gallery in Harare

facts.label: Collection claim (self-described)

parts.text: Chapungu is a 20-acre sculpture park on the outskirts of Harare showing Zimbabwean stone sculpture, also called Shona sculpture. It began as a small gallery in the city and its founder is named as Roy Guthrie.
